  include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

  // -------------------------------------------------------
  // 4.2 无人机（高空无人机通信节点）
  // 部署：机动接入网
  // 通信：1路卫通（16Mbps）+ 1路微波（80Mbps）+ 1路JIDS（2Mbps）
  // -------------------------------------------------------
  platform_type MISSION_UAV_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
    radar_signature DRONE_SIG

    mover WSF_AIR_MOVER
      update_interval 1 sec
    end_mover

    // 卫星链路
    comm sat_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
            transfer_rate constant 16 mbits/sec  //界面配置
            //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
      end_medium

      transmitter
        frequency 14.2 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 20 MHz   //界面配置
        power 20 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern SAT_UAV_CLUSTER_WIDEBAND_ANTENNA

        //衰减模型写死
        attenuation_model none
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 11.8 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 20 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern SAT_UAV_CLUSTER_WIDEBAND_ANTENNA
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm

    // 微波链路
    comm microwave_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
          channels 4
          mode "default"
              transfer_rate constant 80 mbits/sec   //界面配置
              //bit_error_probability 0.00001
          end_mode
      end_medium
      //channels 4

      transmitter
        frequency 8.2 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 50 MHz   //界面配置
        power 20 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern MICRO_UAV_OMNI_ANTENNA
        //写死
        attenuation_model none
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 8.2 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 50 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern MICRO_UAV_OMNI_ANTENNA
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm

    // C波段上行（SNR→速率分档）
    comm c_band_uplink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
          channels 4
        mode "default"
            transfer_rate constant 2000000 bit/s   //界面配置
            //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
      end_medium
      //channels 4

      transmitter
        frequency 4.5 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 10 MHz   //界面配置
        power 20 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        //antenna_tilt -3 deg
        
        attenuation_model none  // 关闭衰减模型
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 4.5 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 10 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        //antenna_tilt -3 deg
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm

    // C波段下行（SNR→速率分档）
    comm c_band_downlink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
          transfer_rate constant 8000000 bit/s   //界面配置
          //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
      end_medium
      //channels 4

      transmitter
        frequency 4.0 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 20 MHz   //界面配置
        power 30 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        antenna_tilt -3 deg
        attenuation_model none
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 4.0 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 20 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        antenna_tilt -3 deg
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm

    // L波段上行（SNR→速率分档）
    comm l_band_uplink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
          transfer_rate constant 12800 bit/s   //界面配置
          //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
      end_medium
      //channels 4
      transmitter
        frequency 1.5 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 5 MHz   //界面配置
        power 10 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        attenuation_model none
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 1.5 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 5 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm

    // L波段下行（SNR→速率分档）
    comm l_band_downlink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
      on
      network_name COM_MESH_NET
      add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
          channels 4
          mode "default"
          transfer_rate constant 4000000 bit/s   //界面配置
          //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
      end_medium
      //channels 4
      transmitter
        frequency 1.3 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 10 MHz   //界面配置
        power 15 W   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        attenuation_model none
        end_attenuation_model
      end_transmitter

      receiver
        frequency 1.3 GHz   //界面配置
        bandwidth 10 MHz   //界面配置
        polarization vertical
        antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_UAV_ANTENNA
        noise_figure 3 dB   //界面配置
      end_receiver

      internal_link script_proc
    end_comm


    processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
      report_to commander via microwave_link
      update_interval 1 sec

      script_variables
        //中继机实例名列表（界面配置时写入，与 link_calc 的 relay_uav_names 保持一致）
        Array<string> relayNames = { "mission_uav_01" };
        bool isRelay = false;
      end_script_variables

      on_initialize
        foreach (string name in relayNames)
          if (name == PLATFORM.Name())
            isRelay = true;
      end_on_initialize

      execute at_interval_of 5 sec
        if (!isRelay)
        {
          // ── 返向侦察视频 ──
          string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts != "")
          {
            Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
            Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_out_port_name").Split("|");
            Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
            Array<string> sizes = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_data_size").Split("|");
            foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts)
            {
              WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
              msg.SetType("kReturnReconVideo");
              msg.SetSizeInBits((int)sizes[i]);
              msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
              PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins[i]);
            }
          }

          // ── 返向状态 ──
          string nxts2 = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_next_platform_name");
          if (nxts2 != "")
          {
            Array<string> nexts2 = nxts2.Split("|");
            Array<string> outs2  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_out_port_name").Split("|");
            Array<string> ins2   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
            Array<string> sizes2 = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconStatus_data_size").Split("|");
            foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts2)
            {
              WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
              msg.SetType("kReturnReconStatus");
              msg.SetSizeInBits((int)sizes2[i]);
              msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
              PLATFORM.Comm(outs2[i]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins2[i]);
            }
          }
        }
      end_execute

      // ========== 消息接收处理 ==========
      on_message
        type kReturnReconVideo
          script
            string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_platform_name");
            if (nxts != "") {
              Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
              Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_out_port_name").Split("|");
              Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
              foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts) {
                PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxt, ins[i]);   // 原样转发
              }
            }
          end_script

        type kReturnReconStatus
          script
            string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_platform_name");
            if (nxts != "") {
              Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
              Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_out_port_name").Split("|");
              Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
              foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts) {
                PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxt, ins[i]);   // 原样转发
              }
            }
          end_script

        type kForwardTarget
          script
            string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_platform_name");
            if (nxts != "") {
              Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
              Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_out_port_name").Split("|");
              Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
              foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts) {
                PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxt, ins[i]);   // 原样转发
              }
            }
          end_script

        type kForwardSituation
          script
            string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_platform_name");
            if (nxts != "") {
              Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
              Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_out_port_name").Split("|");
              Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kReturnReconVideo_next_in_port_name").Split("|");
              foreach (int i : string nxt in nexts) {
                PLATFORM.Comm(outs[i]).SendMessage(MESSAGE, nxt, ins[i]);   // 原样转发
              }
            }
          end_script

        default
          script
            writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
          end_script

      end_on_message
    end_processor

  end_platform_type
